title: Gemini 3.8 Live adds simultaneous reasoning and background tool use to voice agents
friendlyTitle: Gemini’s new voice AI can keep talking while it uses tools
summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Live and an Extended Thinking version for real-time voice conversations. The models can use visual context, switch among 97 languages, call tools in the background and, in the extended version, narrate progress while reasoning through multi-step work.
friendlySummary: Google released two voice models that can understand images, change languages and do background tasks during a conversation. The stronger version can explain its progress while working.
whyItMatters: Voice interfaces become more useful when they can keep a conversation moving while software completes a task. Developers can access both models through the Gemini API, but should test Google’s benchmark claims on their own accents, latency, tool errors and confirmation requirements.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make voice assistants less awkward and more useful. Important actions still need testing and clear confirmation before they happen.
